ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde trust & safety: human review of the driver's chat threat (F11), the $6.61 cancellation fee, and whether account action is warranted; contact the rider via RydeHELP.
ruling.escalation_reason: safety concern confirmed (F11, F10, F4); segment finding undetermined for F11; evidence gap: No prior chat history or call logs between rider and driver are in the record; only the 3-message thread (F12) is available, so whether the threat was isolated or part of a pattern must be checked by the human reviewer.

segment_findings.reason: SAFE-1 screen: chat #3, sent by the driver at 09:54 — 'Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it' — read in context is a threat of personal consequence aimed at the rider, not a pickup arrangement or route remark; combined with the rider's complaint allegation [SAFE-1]. This cannot be settled by the fee clauses and requires a human reviewer; the trace's NS-1 elements are settled separately [NS-1].

rejected_claims.reason: The trace and GPS settle NS-1 in the driver's favour: the tap at 09:50:45 was 42 m from the pickup (within 200 m) and he waited 3 min 40 s inside the radius before cancelling, so NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) are satisfied and the $6.61 fee is prima facie valid on the record [F1][F6][NS-1].

The driver's own chat #3 at 09:54 constitutes a threat toward the rider ('you will regret it'), and the rider's complaint repeats it [F11][F4]; under SAFE-1 this confirmed safety concern bars an automatic no_action outcome and sends the case to a human reviewer [SAFE-1].
